name: Confluence Cloud
covers: Pages, spaces, search, comments, labels, attachments
credential: Atlassian account email and API token
credentialNote: Sent as Basic auth with the account's email address, which goes in email. The default connection uses TOIL_JIRA_CLOUD_API_TOKEN when no token is set; another connection can borrow a Jira Cloud connection's token with apiTokenFrom

supported.api: REST API v2, with v1 for CQL search, labels and uploads
supported.note: Confluence Cloud is always current. toil calls REST API v2 (/wiki/api/v2) and, where v2 has no endpoint, v1 (/wiki/rest/api: CQL search, adding and removing labels, attachment uploads), with an Atlassian account email and API token sent as Basic auth. Nothing has been run against a live site yet.
